info.title: Microsoft Release Communications MCP
info.description: Connector for Microsoft Release Communications (MRC). Exposes the MRC MCP Server for Copilot Studio agents plus the underlying OData and RSS endpoints for Power Automate and Power Apps. Covers Microsoft 365 Roadmap and Azure Updates. No authentication is required.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint that proxies JSON-RPC requests to the Microsoft Release Communications MCP Server for Microsoft 365 Roadmap and Azure Updates data.

get.description: Queries Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts using OData. Returns full untruncated descriptions and supports page sizes larger than the 50 item limit of the MCP tools.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter expression. Example: products/any(p: p eq 'Microsoft Teams') and status eq 'Launched'

parameters.name: $search
parameters.description: Free text search across post titles.

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Sort expression. Example: created desc

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Comma separated list of properties to return. Example: id,title,status

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: When true, includes the total matching item count in the response.

get.description: Queries Azure Updates posts using OData. Returns full untruncated descriptions and supports page sizes larger than the 50 item limit of the MCP tools.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter expression. Example: tags/any(t: t eq 'Retirements') and availabilities/any(a: a/ring eq 'Retirement' and a/year eq 2026)

parameters.name: $search
parameters.description: Free text search across post titles.

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Sort expression. Example: created desc

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Comma separated list of properties to return. Example: id,title,status

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: When true, includes the total matching item count in the response.

get.summary: When a Microsoft 365 roadmap item is published
get.description: Polling trigger that fires when new posts appear on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap. Configure the trigger to filter on the created field so each poll returns only posts published since the previous run.
get.x-ms-trigger-hint: To see it work, wait for new features to be published to the Microsoft 365 Roadmap. The underlying data refreshes daily.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter used to select new posts. Use a created comparison for trigger state, optionally combined with other criteria. Example: created gt 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z and products/any(p: p eq 'Microsoft Teams')

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Sort expression. Keep the default so the newest post is first.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of posts to return per poll.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Comma separated list of properties to return. Example: id,title,status,created

200.description: Microsoft 365 roadmap posts published since the previous poll

get.summary: When an Azure update is published
get.description: Polling trigger that fires when new posts appear on Azure Updates. Configure the trigger to filter on the created field so each poll returns only posts published since the previous run.
get.x-ms-trigger-hint: To see it work, wait for new posts to be published to Azure Updates. The underlying data refreshes daily.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter used to select new posts. Use a created comparison for trigger state, optionally combined with other criteria. Example: created gt 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z and tags/any(t: t eq 'Retirements')

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Sort expression. Keep the default so the newest post is first.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of posts to return per poll.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Comma separated list of properties to return. Example: id,title,status,created

200.description: Azure update posts published since the previous poll

get.description: Returns the Microsoft 365 Roadmap RSS 2.0 feed. Useful for scheduled flows that watch for newly published roadmap posts.
Returns the Azure Updates RSS 2.0 feed. Useful for scheduled flows that watch for newly published Azure update posts.

Availability.description: A release milestone for a post.

ring.description: Release ring, such as General Availability, Preview, or Retirement.

year.description: Four digit year of the milestone.

month.description: Month name of the milestone, such as February.

id.description: Feature ID of the roadmap post.

description.description: Full description of the feature as HTML.

status.description: Status such as Launched, Rolling out, or In development.

platforms.description: Platforms the feature applies to, such as Web, Desktop, iOS, or Android.

releaseRings.description: Release rings, such as General Availability or Targeted Release.

cloudInstances.description: Cloud instances, such as Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, or DoD.

moreInfoUrls.description: Additional reference links for the feature.

generalAvailabilityDate.description: General availability month in YYYY-MM format.

previewAvailabilityDate.description: Preview availability month in YYYY-MM format.

created.description: When the post was published to the roadmap.

modified.description: When the post was last updated.

id.description: Identifier of the Azure update post.

description.description: Full description of the update as HTML.

status.description: Status such as Launched, In preview, or In development.

products.description: Azure products the update applies to.

productCategories.description: Product categories, such as Compute, Databases, or Networking.

tags.description: Tags, such as Features, Retirements, Security, or Services.

availabilities.description: Release milestones for the update, including retirement timing.

generalAvailabilityDate.description: General availability month in YYYY-MM format.

previewAvailabilityDate.description: Public preview month in YYYY-MM format.

privatePreviewAvailabilityDate.description: Private preview month in YYYY-MM format.

created.description: When the post was published to Azure Updates.

modified.description: When the post was last updated.

M365RoadmapResponse.description: OData response containing Microsoft 365 roadmap items.

@odata.count.description: Total number of matching items. Returned when Include Count is true.

@odata.count.description: Total number of matching items. Returned when Include Count is true.
